text: Carpentry is a skilled trade that involves the creation of various structures, furniture, and building components. It demands accuracy, persistence, and a profound grasp of several techniques. Carpenters employ a variety of tools, including chisels, planes, and saws, to shape joints and form the final structure. A critical finishing detail is the application of varnish, which not only enhances the appearance of the finished piece but also safeguards it from environmental damage.
